description: Figure 7 illustrates the change in KV cache size over time, measured in milliseconds (ms), for different models and configurations. The x-axis is labeled “time (ms)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2524.45, with tick marks at intervals of 252.45. The y-axis is labeled “KV cache size (MB)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, with tick marks at intervals of 100. There are four lines displayed: a solid blue line representing “Vanilla” which begins at approximately 320 MB at 0 ms and increases to approximately 333.6 MB at 2524.45 ms; a solid orange line representing “SepLLM (n=64)” which begins at approximately 320 MB at 0 ms and increases to approximately 333.6 MB at 2524.45 ms; a dashed orange line representing “SepLLM (n=128)” which begins at approximately 320 MB at 0 ms and increases to approximately 333.6 MB at 2524.45 ms; and a dashed green line representing “SepLLM (n=256)” which begins at approximately 320 MB at 0 ms and increases to approximately 333.6 MB at 2524.45 ms. All four lines exhibit a generally increasing trend with minor fluctuations throughout the duration of the plot.
